discrete_energy.acceptance_form: energy error remains bounded over the frozen run and decreases at second order until the solver/numerical floor

discrete_exchange.boundary_flux: periodic telescoping sum must vanish independently
discrete_exchange.local_residual: computed from independently evolved sector energies and source work terms

discrete_symmetry_and_constraints.Gauss_preservation: exact for the algebraic discrete solution and bounded by nonlinear solver residual in floating-point execution
discrete_symmetry_and_constraints.continuity_identity: derived as the discrete Noether identity, not separately imposed
discrete_symmetry_and_constraints.total_charge_zero_mode: sum_n a J0_n=0 is an initial-data admissibility condition

domain.space: periodic S1 with N sites and spacing a=L/N

gauge.diagnostic_phase_pin: one reference-site phase, excluded from dynamics
gauge.link_transform: U_n -> exp(-i alpha_n) U_n exp(+i alpha_(n+1))

holonomy_controls.large_gauge_behavior: link-angle zero mode shifts by an allowed winding while W is invariant

lattice_variables.A1: group-valued links U_n=exp(i q_1p1 a A1_n/hbar)
lattice_variables.Pi2_Pi3: real site momenta at the compatible midpoint time location
lattice_variables.electric_flux: real link momentum E_n conjugate to the link angle
lattice_variables.spinors: four two-component site spinors psi_(s,r), stored as two sector doublets per charge species
lattice_variables.uniform_mode: spatial link-angle zero mode with conjugate uniform electric flux and exact E_zero^2 L/(2 mu_0) energy

nonclaims: no pure 1+1 truncation or transverse decoupling
no stable classical fermionic matter or fermionic QFT
no quantum pair creation, Fermi statistics, or quantized electromagnetism
no pillar completion, seam closure, new physics, C_k dynamics, CCFT, or master-action validation

pilot_policy.canonical_threshold_rule: twice the maximum corresponding pilot residual, rounded upward to one significant digit, while preserving expected refinement order
pilot_policy.solver_rule: solver error <=0.01 times estimated finest-grid truncation error

spatial_operators.Wilson_laplacian: (2 psi_n-U_n^sigma psi_(n+1)-U_(n-1)^(-sigma) psi_(n-1))/(2a) multiplied by r beta
spatial_operators.covariant_centered_derivative: (U_n^sigma psi_(n+1)-U_(n-1)^(-sigma) psi_(n-1))/(2a), sigma=+1 for q and -1 for -q
spatial_operators.transverse_site_coupling: q_s psi_s^dagger [alpha2 phi2_n+alpha3 phi3_n] psi_s with alphaI=gamma0 gammaI

time_integrator.fixed_step_energy_caveat: implicit midpoint is not assumed to conserve the nonlinear continuum Hamiltonian exactly
time_integrator.nonlinear_system: all links, electric fluxes, descendants, momenta, and spinors solved at the common midpoint
